newsitem.title: USA: Nasdaq ends slightly firmer, but techs sag.
newsitem.headline: Nasdaq ends slightly firmer, but techs sag.

text.p: Nasdaq shares snapped a two-day losing streak and ended slightly higher Friday, despite lackluster performance by several technology issues.
The Nasdaq composite index gained 1.77 points or 0.12 percent to close unofficially at 1438.15. Advancing issues beat decliners 2350 to 1867 on total volume of 560 million shares.

"It's the end of the quarter, so people migrated towards what they think are more stable stocks and shied away from techs. People are a bit more cautious, so they stayed off to the side," one trader said.
Intel Corp, Dell Computer Corp, and Microsoft Corp each lost ground.
PacifiCare Health Systems Inc plunged 6-1/2 to 59-3/8 after the managed health care company said its second quarter results would fall sharply below expectations.

Syquest Technology Inc, the most active Nasdaq issue, gained 21/32 to 2-1/2 after the company said revenues for the third quarter ending in June will exceed those of the second quarter. VLSI Technology Inc gained 2-11/16 to 25-1/4 after Salomon Brothers upgraded the stock to strong buy from hold.
